purpose: Add the whole-home V4 floorplan contract and geometry-only candidate policy without changing accepted V3 behavior
implemented: New reconstruction tasks default to all visible rooms while structure remains complete.
floorplanScope supports functional-area inclusion and exclusion, and code recomputes targetRoomIds after room-label consolidation.
V4 object candidates carry deterministic roomIds and no living-room category hints or fixed-entry exclusions.
The residential category contract covers beds, wardrobes, kitchen units, appliances and bathroom fixtures.
Bed and nightstand groups use group_sleep; other deterministic primary/satellite candidates can use group_cluster.
The capacity contract accepts 300 furniture objects and 100 patch commands; the 301st object fails closed.
SceneProgram projection prefers compiled object-to-room ownership and falls back to nearest room labels only for old plans.
V1/V2/V3 historical task versions and prompts remain separate.
